methodology.prediction: Each selector's decision is compared with the stored best_strategy label. The label is never used as either selector's prediction.
methodology.optimization: Each selector's chosen strategy is applied once to an independent deepcopy of the same original TAC and measured with optimizer.measure.measure_pass.
methodology.separation: Prediction quality and optimization effectiveness are reported separately and are never combined into one number.

rule_based.confusion_matrix_note: Rows/columns follow the target vocabulary in order.

ml.confusion_matrix_note: Rows/columns follow the target vocabulary in order.

optimization.overall_note: Rule-Based achieved a higher mean useful improvement.

limitations: Only 44 held-out samples were evaluated; every metric is preliminary.

The forest has no winning examples for strength_reduction, so the ML selector cannot emit it; a Rule-Based prediction of strength_reduction is outside the target vocabulary and counts as an error while being reported explicitly.
Labels come from the useful_improvement definition in optimizer.measure, so 'correct' means 'matches that definition'.
strength_reduction is a documented no-op, so runs selecting it record zero improvement by construction.
